What Determines the Cost of Windshield Repair Leads?

The cost per lead (CPL) for windshield repair can vary significantly based on your market competition and the channels you use. To maximize efficiency, several factors must be considered:
  • Geographic location and local competition levels
  • Seasonality and storm-related demand
  • Conversion rate of your website and landing pages
  • The effectiveness of your auto repair SEO strategy
High-quality leads usually come from customers actively searching for immediate solutions, making intent the most critical factor in lead acquisition.

To supplement this, running targeted Meta Ads campaigns allows you to reach local drivers who may need glass replacement but have not yet started their active search.
